Query Documentation

Search indexed library documentation for code examples and explanations.

The Two-Step Pattern​

Nexus documentation search works in two steps:

  1. Resolve the library

    Find the library ID using resolve-library

  2. Query documentation

    Search with query-docs using the library ID

Your AI handles this automatically, but understanding it helps you write better prompts.

Example: React Hooks​

Ask your AI:

"How do I properly clean up useEffect in React?"

What happens
1. AI calls resolve-library
   query: "react"
   → Returns: /facebook/react

2. AI calls query-docs
   libraryId: "/facebook/react"
   query: "useEffect cleanup"
   → Returns: Relevant code examples and explanations

Tips for Better Results​

Be Specific​

❌ "Tell me about React"
   → Returns general overview (many tokens)

✓ "How do I clean up subscriptions in useEffect?"
   → Returns specific cleanup pattern (fewer tokens)

Include Context​

❌ "How do middleware work?"
   → Unclear which framework

✓ "How do middleware work in Next.js App Router?"
   → Specific to Next.js middleware

Use Technical Terms​

❌ "How do I make my page load faster?"
   → Too vague

✓ "How do I implement code splitting in Next.js?"
   → Specific technique

Response Formats​

Control verbosity with the tokens parameter:

FormatTokensBest For
full~5,000Debugging, exploration
compact~2,000Normal usage
code-only~1,000Quick examples
summary~500Checking availability

Your AI can request specific formats:

"Search React docs for useState, give me code-only format"

Available Libraries​

Over 50 libraries are indexed, including:

Frontend:

  • React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, SvelteKit
  • Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui

Backend:

  • Node.js, Express, Hono, Fastify
  • tRPC, GraphQL

Databases:

  • Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM
  • PostgreSQL, MongoDB

Cloud:

  • Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, AWS

Tools:

  • TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright

CLI Alternative​

You can also query docs from the command line:

CLI documentation search
nexus docs search react

Found 3 libraries:
  react, react-router, react-query

nexus docs query react "useEffect cleanup"

Found 5 results:
1. Cleaning up Effects
   Return a cleanup function to avoid memory leaks...

Troubleshooting​

"Library not found"​

The library might not be indexed yet. Check available libraries:

"List all available Nexus libraries"

Or submit a request to add it:

"How do I submit a library to Nexus?"

Results not relevant​

Try being more specific:

❌ "database queries"
✓ "Drizzle ORM insert with returning"

Too many tokens​

Request a compact format:

"Search Next.js docs for server actions, compact format"
